text:
alex: :rotating_light: incident-bot just fired a page for Prometheus scrape failures across multiple exporters, seeing scrape_errors and target DOWN. Pager: https://pagerduty.fake/incidents/PD12345

incident-bot: [ALERT] prometheus_scrape_failures_total > 50 in 5m for job=app-metrics-exporter :pager:

alex: paging details show spike started ~2m ago, scrape error 503 from exporter svc in eu-west-1. Also seeing kafka consumer lag rising on log-ingest group.

maria: acked. I'm on it, checking exporter pods and node-level metrics now.

kevin: acked too — if this is a broader scrape stall we might hit dashboards and alerting cascade. oncall-sre, any rotation?

oncall-sre: i'm on standby, joining. how bad is the lag? customer impact?

maria: kafka lag for topic redwood-logs-prod is ~120k msgs, consumer group log-ingest has 20k behind per partition. retention still fine but ingest pipeline is starting to backlog.

alex: initial hypothesis: app-metrics-exporter on eu-west nodes got OOM/killed after a deploy; kubelet reports OOMKilled for exporter-daemonset on node eu-west-2a.

maria: running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=app-metrics-exporter -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring logs deploy/app-metrics-exporter -c exporter | tail -n 80
```
logs show repeated "503 upstream read timeout" and memory spikes.

kevin: plan: 1) cordon and drain the one failing node to kick exporter DaemonSet onto healthy nodes 2) temporarily increase exporter replica resource requests to avoid OOM 3) scale log-ingest consumers by +2 to eat backlog 4) notify CS about delayed metrics/log availability.

eli: saw this alert through PD, flagging customer-impact: a few enterprise customers in eu-west might see delayed dashboards and ingested logs; they should be notified if this persists >30m.

alex: executing step 1 now: `kubectl cordon eu-west-2a && kubectl drain eu-west-2a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force`

incident-bot: deploy-bot started rolling restart of exporter deployment (rollout id r-202403).

maria: bumping consumer replicas: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/log-ingest --replicas=7` — done. consumers rebalanced, lag dropping from 120k -> 70k in ~2m.

kevin: increasing exporter resource limits in staging patch, pushing to prod as hotfix. patch applied to exporter DaemonSet with limits 512Mi -> 1Gi.

alex: exporter pods are coming up on other nodes, target UP count back to normal (from 3/8 -> 7/8 -> 8/8). Prometheus scrape_failures metric trending down.

maria: quick verification query:
```
up{job="app-metrics-exporter"}
# before: 3/8 DOWN
# after: 8/8 UP
```

oncall-sre: good — but Kafka consumer lag still elevated, keep an eye. If it doesn't drop below 10k in 15m, we'll add two more consumers or reassign partitions.

eli: cc @support — beginning customer notification draft: "We're investigating a metrics and log ingestion delay in eu-west; mitigation in progress. Expect reduced delay within 30–60 minutes." anyone want to add details?

kevin: add that we've scaled consumers and restarted exporter DaemonSet; root cause likely OOM on exporter after recent config change. We'll follow up with postmortem once stable.

alex: pagerduty update: acknowledged by maria and kevin, escalation paused. PD incident status -> acknowledged.

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by maria at 2246008890.

maria: lag now 40k and trending down to ~5k in next 10m. CPU on exporter stabilized.

alex: leaving a traceback of commands we used for the postmortem:
```
kubectl cordon eu-west-2a
kubectl drain eu-west-2a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/log-ingest --replicas=7
kubectl -n monitoring set resources daemonset/app-metrics-exporter --limits=memory=1Gi
```

kevin: assigning follow-ups: (1) maria to open a postmortem and attach logs (2) infra to revert the config change that reduced exporter memory (3) platform to add a Prometheus alert suppression for cascade alerts when exporters are being restarted.

maria: will open PM and include timeline + heap dumps.

eli: will send the customer notification in 5m with current mitigations noted.

alex: closing thread for now — keeping PD incident open until lag < 5k. thanks all :thumbsup:
